requirements.text: 3+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping backend systems to production
Strong proficiency in TypeScript, or deep experience in another typed language (Java, Go, C#, Kotlin, Rust) with demonstrated ability to ramp quickly into TypeScript
Hands-on experience designing and operating systems at meaningful scale — handling real traffic, real data volumes, and real users
Solid grasp of backend fundamentals: API design (REST/gRPC), relational and NoSQL databases, messaging/event-driven systems, caching, and concurrency
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD workflows
Production-grade operational mindset: logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, incident response, and a track record of supporting what you ship
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous, startup environment where priorities shift and you're expected to drive your own work
Strong written and verbal communication; able to collaborate across product, design, and other engineering teams
Prior experience at an early or growth-stage startup, ideally one where you helped scale systems from early traction through significant growth
Experience in fintech, wealth management, or other regulated environments (compliance, audit, PII handling)
Background in AI/ML infrastructure, LLM-powered product development, or document processing (OCR, extraction pipelines)
Experience integrating with enterprise platforms used by financial institutions (custodians, CRMs, portfolio management systems)
Exposure to TypeScript ecosystem tools: Node.js, NestJS, tRPC, Prisma, PostgreSQL
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience
